package fixture

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

// writesWorker builds a worker description by concatenating filepath.Join
// RAW into the JSON literal. On Windows the joined path holds backslashes that
// the JSON grammar reads as escapes, so the literal does not parse.
func writesWorker(dir string) {
	body := `{"name":"w","key_file":"` + filepath.Join(dir, "key") + `"}`
	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "worker.json"), []byte(body), 0o644)
}
